data.name: Omaijid
data.gender_notes: Omaijid is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who is devoted to God, one who obeys the commands of Allah. Derived from the root 'amajada' which means to be present or obedient. The name Omaijid carries the meaning “Servant of God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Omaijid usually hope their child will grow to embody servant of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for one who seeks closeness to Allah.
data.etymology: Omaijid belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Servant of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Omaijid total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: عميد
in_arabic.meaning: العميد هو الشخص الذي يتمتع بالشرف و العزة
in_arabic.long_meaning: العميد هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و يعني الشخص الذي يتمتع بالشرف و العزة و المكانة الرفيعة. و هو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة و محمودة في الإسلام و يدل على صفات حسنة مثل الكرامة و العلو.

in_urdu.name: عُمید
in_urdu.meaning: عُمید کا مطلب ہے شرف والا، عزت والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: عُمید ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے شرف والا، عزت والا اور بلند مقام رکھنے والا۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقالید میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے اور اس کے معنی محمود ہیں۔ یہ نام کرامت، عزت اور علو کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: उमैद
in_hindi.meaning: उमैद का अर्थ है सम्मानित, प्रतिष्ठित
in_hindi.long_meaning: उमैद एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है सम्मानित, प्रतिष्ठित और उच्च स्थान रखने वाला। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में महत्वपूर्ण है और इसके अर्थ सुंदर हैं। यह नाम गरिमा, सम्मान और उच्चता को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: عُميد
in_pashto.meaning: عُميد د عزت لرونکی، د شرف لرونکی معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: عُميد د عربي نوم دی چې د عزت لرونکی، د شرف لرونکی او د لوړ مقام لرونکی معنی ورکوي. دا نوم د اسلامي دود په کې مهم دی او د ده معنا ښه دي. دا نوم د کرامت، عزت او لوړتيا څرګندوي.

in_english.name: Omaijid
in_english.long_meaning: Omaijid is a derivative of the Arabic name 'Umayd', which means honorable, esteemed, and high-ranking personality. Etymologically, it stems from the Arabic root 'U-M-Y-D', which connotes meanings related to honor, dignity, and loftiness. In Islamic tradition, the name signifies virtues like prestige, nobility, and elevated status. Historically, it has been used to denote individuals of respect and distinction. The name Omaijid, therefore, embodies spiritual significance, reflecting qualities of moral excellence and high standing within the community.
